bridgeDecisions.decision: Normal documents own routes, history, head, focus, scroll, errors, reloads, links, and forms.
The official SDK may produce a bounded server update without taking over document navigation.
Turbo may own enhanced navigation when explicitly installed with the completed lifecycle bridge.
htmx may own a bounded swap when explicitly installed with the completed lifecycle bridge.
Ticket 0023 remains planned, so no native jQStar navigation example or promise is included.

applicationSpecificRisks: custom swipe action on list rows
theme swatch used as workflow state

capabilities: GET search with local removable enhancement
native validated edit with conflict response

recheckTriggers: A change to the official archived repository statement
A documented application need not covered by normal documents, Datastar, Turbo, or htmx
